mapper.sql: s.id, s.travel_date, s.train_id, s.segment_index, s.seat_type, s.from_station_id, a.station_name AS from_station_name, s.to_station_id, b.station_name AS to_station_name, s.total_count, s.sold_count, s.remaining_count
